dvids.title: USS McFaul completes African circumnavigation transit
dvids.desc: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS McFaul (DDG 74) completed a circumnavigation transit of the African continent, underscoring expeditionary readiness and maritime cooperation with partner nations across the region.
